meta.subject: do not stall the pipeline on raster instruction

en.summary: The commit removes an incorrect decode-stage write stall that was asserted for GPU RASTER instructions.
why_it_counts: The patch is a direct DUT decode fix in a single RTL file
The only functional change is deletion of the is_wstall assignment for the RASTER opcode
An unnecessary decode stall is a real pipeline forward-progress bug
evidence: In the GPU opcode 7'h01, func3 == 3'h0 RASTER case, is_wstall = 1 is removed
All other decode outputs for that instruction remain unchanged

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A decode stage should assert a structural or write stall only when an instruction truly needs a downstream pipeline hold. If a normal executable instruction is mistakenly tagged as requiring a decode-time stall, the front end can block indefinitely whenever that instruction is encountered, even though the execution units are otherwise ready.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The targeted instruction opcode or sub-opcode is decoded
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Mark the instruction as requiring a decode or write stall even though its execution path does not require one
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: set spurious stall bit in decode table
portability_notes: Map this to any decode table or opcode case statement that produces a stall or wait signal for special instructions
The injected bug is especially portable for custom GPU, graphics, or accelerator opcodes that already have dedicated decode cases
Keep destination-register and opcode decode unchanged so the error remains purely a control-stall bug
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the decode case for a non-blocking special instruction
Find the control bit that requests a decode-stage stall, write stall, or pipeline hold
Force that bit high again for the targeted instruction case
Leave all other control outputs unchanged so the injected bug is only the unnecessary stall

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: GPU RASTER decode case in VX_decode
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix deletes the is_wstall assignment from the GPU RASTER decode branch while preserving the rest of the instruction decode.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the RASTER decode case around lines 394 to 398, add back is_wstall = 1.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Raster instructions unnecessarily hold the pipeline, potentially hanging or severely stalling raster workloads.
evidence_for_injection: The patch is a one-line deletion of is_wstall in the RASTER decode case
The instruction still decodes to EX_GPU and INST_GPU_RASTER after the fix
No other files or control paths are involved, so the stall bit is the sole repair point
notes: This is a simple but useful control-bug injection target
A single-line reverse edit is sufficient

zh.summary: 该提交删除了 GPU RASTER 指令在 decode 阶段上被错误拉起的 write stall。
why_it_counts: 补丁是在单个 RTL 文件里对 DUT decode 做的直接修复
唯一的功能性变化，就是删除了 RASTER opcode 对应分支里的 is_wstall 赋值
不必要的 decode stall 属于真实的流水线前向进展缺陷
evidence: 在 GPU opcode 7'h01、func3 == 3'h0 的 RASTER 分支中，is_wstall = 1 被删除
该指令的其他 decode 输出保持不变

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: decode 阶段只有在某条指令确实需要阻塞下游流水线资源时，才应该拉起结构性 stall 或 write stall。如果一个本来可以正常执行的指令被错误标记成必须在 decode 时停住，那么只要遇到该指令，前端就可能无限期阻塞，即便执行单元本身完全可用。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 按指令分类的 decode stall 控制
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 目标指令的 opcode 或 sub-opcode 被译码到
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把该指令错误地标记为需要 decode stall 或 write stall，尽管其执行路径实际上不需要
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 在 decode 表项中设置虚假的 stall 位
portability_notes: 适用于任何在 decode 表或 opcode case 语句中产生 stall/wait 信号的设计
对于已经有专门 decode 分支的自定义 GPU、图形或加速器指令，这类错误尤其容易映射
保持目标寄存器与 opcode decode 不变，使错误纯粹体现为控制型 stall
concrete_injection_steps: 找到某条本不应阻塞的特殊指令对应的 decode 分支
定位请求 decode-stage stall、write stall 或 pipeline hold 的控制位
在该指令分支中重新把该 bit 置高
保持其他控制输出不变，使注入错误只表现为不必要的 stall

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_decode 中的 GPU RASTER decode 分支
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复删除了 GPU RASTER decode 分支中的 is_wstall 赋值，同时保留了该指令的其他译码输出。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在约第 394 到 398 行附近的 RASTER decode 分支里，把 is_wstall = 1 加回来。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: RASTER 指令会无端阻塞流水线，从而导致 raster 工作负载挂起或严重变慢。
evidence_for_injection: 该补丁就是在 RASTER decode 分支中单行删除 is_wstall
修复后该指令仍然译码为 EX_GPU 与 INST_GPU_RASTER
没有其他文件或控制路径参与，因此 stall bit 就是唯一修复点
notes: 这是一个简单但很实用的控制错误注入目标
一行逆向修改即可重现
